title: 🚚️ Repo move wire shapes
description: 🚚️ The five vector files the move cases read. Every one of them records a workspace before an operation, the arguments of that operation, and the workspace, output lines and counters every implementation must produce from it. A workspace is a flat map of slash-separated relative paths, so a fixture never depends on a real filesystem.

Tree.description: 🗄️ One in-memory checkout: every directory that exists on its own, and every file with its content.

Messages.description: 📣️ The command output lines, in order, leading newline included.
